purposes.ids: Map existing ore presentation families, including native ember_vein, without changing stable resource IDs.
purposes.grain_repeats_m: Reuse the C5 shared stone maps at their existing world-scale grain.
purposes.normal_detail_m: Fine shading relief only; no vertex displacement, depth offset or new solid volume.
purposes.stock_transition_m: Soften the boundary between remaining mineral and worked host over 2.5 cm; position uses current native units / full definition units.
purposes.spent_tint: Darken worked host while removing its mineral; keeps the entire unchanged picking ribbon visually present.
purposes.pulse_period_s: Retain C5's pause-aware native-heat pulse period; cold ore never emits except native hover feedback.
purposes.material_finish: Mineral blend 0.88 and source-grain multiplier 0.55 + 1.8*stone.r retain granular detail. Source scar darkening 0.72 distinguishes cracks. Native heat/hover emission retains C5 amplitudes; atlas row edges use half-texel clamps to avoid adjacent-state bleed. No height displacement or additional surface.

projection.purpose: Preserve the original C5 top-surface mineral/scar fields; two states per existing ore. Adapt only texture coordinates to the native 3 m by 0.48 m ribbon.
